page.overview:
Who is Angel?

Angel is a nickname of one of the two Spinoceratops seen in Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous season 4.

Angel is a highly-tinted-blue-skinned herbivorous hybrid of Spinosaurus and Sinoceratops, acquiring traits from both, like the sail of the Spinosaurus. She and her brother were designed to live in cold weather as they are able to generate their own heat.
